changelog:
v3.6.6 — Unified Track Picker

Audio & Subtitles
• The Tracks button now opens the same slide-in panel on both playback engines. Previously, some movies (ones running through the compatible-mode engine) popped up two plain system dialogs back-to-back — audio, then subtitles. Now you get one clean panel with D-pad navigation, gold highlights, and radio buttons no matter which engine is running the stream.
• Off switch for subtitles is always present in both engines.
• Your current audio and subtitle selections are shown up-front.

No other changes.
